name: preadv
synopsis: ssize_t preadv(int fd, const struct iovec *iov, int iovcnt, off_t offset);
description: The preadv() system call reads data into multiple buffers from the file descriptor fd at a specified offset, combining the functionality of readv() and pread(2). It performs the read operation without changing the file offset, and the file must support seeking.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor from which to read

parameters.name: iov
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of iovec structures describing the buffers

parameters.name: iovcnt
parameters.description: Number of elements in the iov array

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: File offset at which the read operation is performed

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes read
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The sum of the iov_len values overflows an ssize_t value
The vector count iovcnt is less than zero or greater than the permitted maximum
An unknown flag is specified (relevant for related calls like preadv2)

bugs: Linux 5.9 and Linux 5.10 have a bug where preadv2() with the RWF_NOWAIT flag may return 0 even when not at end of file.
